inputs.locator: Decision feature: compute exact TA-Lib CCI14 from each complete UTC day's high, low and close typical price, its 14-day simple average and 0.015 times 14-day mean absolute deviation. Start in cash; enter long only when completed-day CCI is strictly above the positive threshold, hold prior state inside the symmetric band, and exit only when CCI is strictly below the negative threshold. Execute a changed target at the next H1 open.

Frozen variants and accounting: primary symmetric thresholds positive and negative 100 and rejection-only neighbors positive and negative 75 and 125, all with period 14. Design is 2020-2022, historical Validation 2023-2024 and fair-reset annual folds 2020-2024. Candidate and buy-and-hold use equity one, zero-yield cash, no leverage or shorting, normal cost 10 bps fee plus 5 bps adverse slippage each side and stress cost 20 plus 10 bps.

Frozen all-pass gates: positive normal and stress returns; Design drawdown at most 95 percent of buy-and-hold and Calmar at least buy-and-hold; Validation drawdown at most 90 percent, upside capture at least 60 percent, Calmar at least buy-and-hold, 2 to 250 position changes, stress drawdown at most normal plus 3pp, positive terminal-liquidation return and cost at most 1pp; both neighbors positive under both costs with non-worse drawdown, at least 75 percent Calmar and 50 percent upside capture; annual normal and stress positive at least 4/5, drawdown non-worse 4/5, Calmar breadth 3/5, upside breadth 4/5, top-year and top-episode contribution at most 60 percent, P90 and terminal holding at most 17520 hours.

objective: Evaluate exactly one frozen TA-Lib-formula-compatible CCI14 symmetric-hysteresis BTC long-or-zero-yield-cash policy on the sealed pre-2025 H1 corpus. Compare the conventional positive and negative 100 primary with rejection-only symmetric 75 and 125 neighbors under matched full-capital buy-and-hold, normal costs and stress costs. Freeze a historical candidate only if every Design, Validation, annual breadth, concentration, drawdown, holding and terminal-inventory gate passes; otherwise permanently close the exact family without tuning. This is historical development evidence, not OOS or Trading authorization.

performance_case.causal_mechanism: CCI scales completed-day typical-price displacement from its rolling mean by mean absolute deviation; crossing the positive extreme may identify strong directional demand while the symmetric negative extreme provides a broad reversal exit and hysteresis reduces threshold churn before next-open execution.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This task may establish only one pre-2025 historical Design and Validation decision for exact TA-Lib-formula-compatible CCI14 symmetric 75, 100 and 125 hysteresis thresholds with 100 primary. It cannot inspect post-2024 data, tune any formula or gate, substitute a neighbor, create Trading behavior, activate a strategy or open OOS unless every frozen gate passes.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: The policy is valuable only if dispersion-scaled hysteresis exits enough sustained adverse paths to meet strict drawdown and Calmar gates without sacrificing required upside, hiding losses in terminal inventory or concentrating gains in one year or episode.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: One frozen low-cost screen either produces a historical candidate for independent OOS or closes the exact CCI14 symmetric 75/100/125 family before optimization or runtime work consumes capacity.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: The completed-day CCI14 positive-100 enter and negative-100 exit state improves after-cost risk-adjusted performance versus matched full-capital buy-and-hold in both Design and historical Validation, with stable symmetric 75 and 125 neighbors and broad annual support.

decision_time.availability_rule: All daily high, low and close inputs through completed day D and the prior thirteen completed days are known before the next H1 open; no incomplete day or later bar is used.
